parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description: The language of the response. Valid values: zh (default): Chinese. en: English.

parameters.name: AuthResourceConfig
parameters.description: The YAML configuration for complex mode.

parameters.name: AuthResourceList
parameters.description: The list of authorization rules for authentication. Multiple rule conditions have an OR relationship. Multiple matching items within a rule condition have an AND relationship.

sub_parameters.name: AuthResourceHeaderList
sub_parameters.description: The request headers of the rule. Currently only used for custom authentication.

sub_parameters.name: DomainId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the domain name in the rule.

sub_parameters.name: IgnoreCase
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether case sensitivity is enabled for the path. This parameter is used when creating custom authentication. Other authentication types enable case sensitivity by default. Valid values:

- true: case sensitivity is enabled.
- false: case sensitivity is disabled.

sub_parameters.name: MatchType
sub_parameters.description:
The matching type for the request path. Valid values:

- EQUAL: exact match.
- PRE: prefix match.
- ERGULAR: regular expression match.

sub_parameters.name: Path
sub_parameters.description: The matching path of the rule.

parameters.name: AuthResourceMode
parameters.description:
The authorization resource mode. Valid values:

- 0: simple mode.
- 1: complex mode.

parameters.name: ClientId
parameters.description: The application ID registered with the service. This parameter is used for OIDC/IDaaS.

parameters.name: ClientSecret
parameters.description: The application secret registered with the OIDC authentication service.

parameters.name: CookieDomain
parameters.description:
The cookie domain name. After authentication succeeds, the cookie is sent to the specified domain name to maintain the logon state.

Example: If you set `Cookie-domain=a.example.com`, the cookie is sent to the domain name `a.example.com`. If you set `Cookie-domain=.example.com`, the cookie is sent to all subdomains of `example.com`.

parameters.name: DeleteResourceIdList
parameters.description: The list of resource record IDs to delete.

parameters.name: ExternalAuthZJSON
parameters.description: The custom authentication information.

parameters.name: GatewayUniqueId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the gateway.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The authentication rule ID.

parameters.name: IsWhite
parameters.description:
The authorization blacklist/whitelist mode. Valid values:

- true: whitelist mode. Hosts and paths in the list can be accessed without verification. All others require verification.
- false: blacklist mode. Hosts and paths in the list require verification. All others can be accessed directly.

parameters.name: Issuer
parameters.description:
Used when the authentication type is JWT or OIDC:

- JWT: the iss (issuer) in JWT claims, which specifies the token issuer.
- OIDC: the iss (issuer) in OIDC claims, which specifies the token issuer.

parameters.name: Jwks
parameters.description: The JWT public key. JSON format is supported.

parameters.name: LoginUrl
parameters.description: The user logon page URL of the IDaaS instance. This parameter is used for IDaaS.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The authentication name.

parameters.name: RedirectUrl
parameters.description: The redirect URL after successful authorization. This parameter is used for OIDC/IDaaS and must be consistent with the redirect URL configured in OIDC/IDaaS.

parameters.name: ScopesList
parameters.description: The OIDC authorization scopes. This parameter is used for OIDC.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The enabled status. Valid values:

- false: disabled.
- true: enabled.

parameters.name: Sub
parameters.description: Used when the authentication type is JWT. The sub (subject) in JWT claims, which specifies the principal. Make sure that the value of the sub field in the JWT payload is consistent with the value configured here. If this parameter is not set or is empty, the value defaults to the value of the Issuer parameter.

parameters.name: TokenName
parameters.description:
The location where the JWT token is stored.

The token parameter information to be verified. By default, the token is placed in the Authorization header with the Bearer prefix. Example: `Authorization: Bearer token`.

parameters.name: TokenNamePrefix
parameters.description:
The prefix of the JWT token.

The token parameter information to be verified. By default, the token is placed in the Authorization header with the Bearer prefix. Example: `Authorization: Bearer token`.

parameters.name: TokenPass
parameters.description: Specifies whether to pass through the token.

parameters.name: TokenPosition
parameters.description:
The JWT token type. Valid values:

- HEADER: transmitted through a header.

The token parameter information to be verified. By default, the token is placed in the Authorization header with the Bearer prefix. Example: Authorization: Bearer token.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The authentication type. Valid values:

- JWT
- OIDC
- IDaaS
- ExternalAuthZ: a self-managed authentication service.
